messages:
Sam: Heads up — our package `exports` tweak in @redwood/sdk is breaking several sample apps on edge runtimes.
Mira: Oh no, what are users seeing?
Sam: Repro on Next edge: build fails during prerender with module resolution errors. Short log:
```
Error: Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk/client'
    at Module._resolveFilename (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
```
Sam: The SDK `package.json` now uses conditional exports like:
```
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js", "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" },
  "./client": { "import": "./dist/esm/client.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/client.js" }
}
```
Leo: TS projects also hit `Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/sdk/client'` because `./client` had no `types` condition.
Jess: Steps to reproduce? I can run a quick build.
Sam: Clone `samples/sdk-next-edge`, `pnpm i`, `pnpm build`. Fails in prerender step. CI reproducible too.
CI-bot: build #3421 — samples/sdk-next-edge — FAILED (link: ci.internal/build/3421)
Chris: Temporary workaround: import deep ESM path `@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/client` or pin older SDK version. Not great.
Mira: Edge bundlers (Next/Esbuild) can fail if none of the `exports` conditions match their resolution. Also TS resolver needs `types` for subpaths or `typesVersions` to map.
Sam: We also saw some users hit `ReferenceError: require is not defined` when bundler accidentally resolved the `require` path for runtime in edge.
Leo: For compatibility we should ensure `import` condition exists for all public subpaths and add `types` entries. Consider `"./*": "./dist/*"`? Might expose internals.
Jess: I can validate adding `types` to `./client` fixes the TS errors quickly.
Mira: Plan: I will open a PR to adjust `exports` to explicitly include `./client` with `types` + `import` and add a CI job that builds Next edge samples.
Mira: Draft PR: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/987 (WIP)
Chris: Also add a regression test that runs `pnpm build` on `samples/sdk-next-edge` and fails the PR if it breaks.
Sam: Good. Also add `typesVersions` mapping for TS to prefer `dist/types/*` when consuming `@redwood/sdk/*`.
Leo: Reminder: various bundlers treat `exports` wildcard differently. We should add a short note in SDK README about best import patterns for edge runtimes.
Jess: I'll smoke-test PR on Node 20 and in a Next 13 reproduction container.
Mira: If patch is small I'll backport to the last minor release so sample-apps don't immediately break for new installs.
Chris: Also warn support/onboarding — lots of new teams use the Next edge sample during trials.
Support-bot: Notified #support with a summary and linked repro.
Sam: Until fix lands, share this temporary snippet for folks:
```
import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/client'
```
Mira: Ugly but works. I'll post updates in this thread once PR is up.
Sam: Thanks — prioritize exports/types + samples CI + migration note.
Mira: On it :rocket:
